prior_art: docs/requirements.yaml (QRY-05, SBX-01, SBX-02, SBX-03 requirement bodies)

task.description:
Produce a design artefact for the 4 stage-17 requirements below. Write to src/design/WF02-qry05-sbx01-03-20260818.md on the feature branch.

## Requirements

### QRY-05: Server-side field stripping on query results
- Fields the caller has no read grant for SHALL be removed from every item before serialisation
- Stripped field is ABSENT (not null/empty/redacted)
- Stripping happens on the server
- Stripped field not usable as filter/sort unless caller has read grant
- Builds on QRY-01 (entity query endpoint)

### SBX-01: Orchestrator role gate on task-spec submission
- `POST /api/v1/agent/task-specs` requires BOTH `agent.submit_task_spec` scope AND `tenant_orchestrator` realm role
- Either alone → HTTP 403 `orchestrator_role_required`
- Token with BOTH `tenant_orchestrator` AND `tenant_implementer` → HTTP 403 `conflicting_agent_roles`
- Check in request handler (not gateway)
- Appends `TaskSpecSubmissionRejected` audit event on rejection

### SBX-02: Server-authoritative orchestrator principal
- Handler sets `spec.orchestrator_principal` = verified token subject (server side)
- Any client-supplied `orchestrator_principal` in body is DISCARDED silently
- `spec_hash` (AGT-04) computed over canonical JSON with server-set principal
- Appends `TaskSpecSubmitted` audit event with principal recorded

### SBX-03: Orchestrator excluded from sandbox claim
- Sandbox claim endpoint rejects `tenant_orchestrator` token → HTTP 403 `orchestrator_may_not_claim`
- Requires `tenant_implementer` role; without it → HTTP 403 `implementer_role_required`
- Orchestrator CAN call GET /api/v1/agent/sandboxes (read-only supervisory view of all tenant sandboxes)
- Implementer GET /api/v1/agent/sandboxes restricted to their own sandboxes
- Appends `SandboxClaimRejected` on rejection

## Design requirements
- Define the new fields/structs/types needed
- Specify the exact Zig function signatures for new handler logic
- Specify DB schema changes if any (migration file names)
- Describe the data flow for each requirement
- Cover all acceptance criteria
- NO implementation code — interfaces and contracts only
- Must be complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity

result.summary: Design for QRY-05, SBX-01, SBX-02, SBX-03 -- types: [E] (all novel/cross-cutting). Two migrations, four new modules, two existing modules extended.
